facts.fact: Burkina Faso's minister Aminata Zerbo/Sabane chaired, with her Malian and Nigerien counterparts, an Alliance of Sahel States ministerial session in Ouagadougou on 27 November 2026 that validated a draft framework convention on digital and postal cooperation.

BFA.note: Only a draft convention was validated; no signature or act in effect stated.

facts.fact: Mali's minister Alhamdou Ag Ilyene took part in the Alliance of Sahel States ministerial session in Ouagadougou on 27 November 2026 that validated a draft framework convention on digital and postal cooperation.
